asipattavana.p: [Asipatta+vana] (na) CL=9 A forest with leaves made of sword; Sword leaf hell.
pn: Asipattavana. One of the tortures of purgatory. In the distance the grove appears as a mango grove, and when the inhabitants of purgatory enter, wishing to eat the mangoes, leaves which are sharp like swords fall on them, cutting off their limbs. Sn.vs.673; Snp-a.ii.481.
a: အသိပတ္တဝန(န)
သန်လျက်ဖြင့် ပြီးသော အရွက်ရှိသော တော၊ သန်လျက်ရွက်တောငရဲ။
